name: Waynflete Summer Camp
description_short: Summer camp program run by Waynflete school in Portland, Maine, offering weekly camp sessions over seven weeks for ages 4–16. Options include sports, performing arts, nature, STEM and coding, arts, Dungeons & Dragons, and a Counselor-in-Training program.

warnings: The 2026 season is over and the 2027 details are not out yet. The page says: "THANK YOU FOR A GREAT SEASON! Stay tuned for 2027 camp information." The camp lineup shown may be from the past season and could change.

Age and grade ranges differ by program (Mini Flyers ages 4-5, CIT ages 14-16, others listed by grade K-12). grade_min 0 stands for kindergarten.
